## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Security and compatibility

Describe upstream permissions, write actions, data exposure, migrations,
breaking changes, or state why none apply.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Visual contracts run when geometry or responsive behavior changed
- [ ] New or changed behavior has automated coverage
- [ ] User, deployment, and security documentation is updated where needed
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for meaningful UI changes
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, cookies, keys, live state, real topology, raw API
      responses, `.env`, data volumes, or release archives are included
- [ ] New service marks include provenance and permitted-use documentation

## Notes for reviewers

Call out areas that need special attention and any checks that could not run.
